description: See each thread's project, pull request state, and uncommitted changes at a glance in any sidebar organization. Each row gets a colored tag with the project's name and a stable dot color per project. Pull requests get bb's own git glyphs tinted by state — draft, open, checks, conflicts, merged, closed — and threads with uncommitted edits get a file-diff tag with green-red line counts. Every item can be toggled, recolored, or re-iconed in the plugin's settings. Needs the Rows → Metadata sidebar option and bb's threadRowMetadata experiment, both off by default.
